doc.time_base: seconds from first sample of the WAV (48 kHz). 10 Hz frames cover [t, t+0.1).
doc.rms_db: mix RMS per frame, dBFS (mono sum)
doc.loud_0_1: rms_db min-max normalized (2nd pct of non-silent .. 99.5th pct)
doc.onset: librosa onset strength of the mix, max over the frame (arbitrary units)
doc.vocal_active: 1 if RoFormer RMS > -40 dB and demucs vocal RMS > -42 dB
doc.sung: 1 if inside an aligned lyric word (incl. wordless Ahh)
